He could in the right system. Before you write me off let me explain why and give an example of how it has been done before extremely successfully. Juve 14/15 had Pirlo playing as a central midfielder with very little running (he was mid 30's at that point so he didn't have the strength in his legs anymore) to amazing effect. It worked as they played a 3 man midfield with 2 powerhouse box to box mids in Pogba and Vidal playing alongside him who did all of the running and defensive work which allowed Pirlo to play make from deep and drift around finding space. Chelsea in 16/17 with the 343 also managed to show how Messi could end up playing in the midfield in the role which Fabregas ended up playing that season. Brought in for the games in which Barca will be expected to dominate (which would be most in the season, unlike Chelsea which had comparatively much harder fixtures more often) and used as a super sub in tougher games where Barcelona are struggling to open the opposition defence up. In Barca's current system I'll agree that he'd be too much of a defensive liability to be worth playing however for how much he means to Barca I don't believe it would be a stretch to assume they'd shape their system around him as he eventually enters the later years of his career.

It's a mini version though, Slot inherited an uber fit squad from Klopp and his fitness-light approach saw us walk the league with minimal injuries, similar to Carrick getting a fit Amorim squad and boosting morale with a light workload giving them a strong end to last season. both had hard fall offs once their approach took grip, we barely made it into the CL last year and they are racking up embarrassing defeats while being totally out worked. Yes Slot won more, but our squad is and was also far superior to theirs and that's why we could win a league and passively stumble into 5th whereas their peak was 3rd place well of the top 2 and now looking down the barrel of a return to the bottom half of the table. Though I do think it's important to acknowledge that Slot is a much better coach that Carrick. The levels are different but the arc is the same.
